This is as good as it gets here
Feb 2021 • Family
In fact there are 3 restaurants I've been to here - an Italian (3 times), an Indian (twice), and a Vietnamese restaurant (once). I'm going to comment on all of them - they're all top notch. Pricier than a standard place, but this is 5 star food and 5 star service. Today in the Italian, we had veal, caprese salad, some ravioli, and some Bolognese for my small daughter. It was all very high standard, as it is every time we come. Last night we went to Vietnamese restaurant, had been (something with 5 spice sauce), shrimp spring rolls, braised tofu, and spag bol again (not very imaginative daughter). The are the first 2 and they were both beyond expectations. Tonight we need to try something different. We haven't been to the Indian this holiday yet.

다 좋은데 음식이 좀 달았습니다 (everying is good except that the food is a little too sweet)
Jun 2019 • Family
호텔처럼 직원들도 친절하고 서비스도 좋은 음식점입니다. 음식도 정갈하고 맛있습니다. 그럼에도 불구하고 별 5개를 주지 못하는 이유는 음식이 전반적으로 좀 너무 달았습니다.

세번 가서 저녁을 먹었는데, 생선요리(clay pot cobia), 쇠고기 요리(shaking beef), 스프(phu quoc canh chua), 모두 너무 달았습니다. 특히 샐러드(crispy green papaya salad )는 아주 많이 달았습니다. 제가 단맛을 좋아하지 않는 편이지만, 그래도 베트남 음식이 이렇게 달지가 않은데 아마 서양인들 입맛에 맞추려고 한게 아닌가 싶기도 하더군요.

그러나 메뉴에 없는 피자(pepperoni pizza)도 부탁했더니 아주 맛있게 만들어주셔서 잘 먹었습니다. 스테이크 종류도 다양합니다. 비올 때, 나가기 귀찮을 때 한번 들러보세요. 맛있습니다.

Simply great food (and service)!
Mar 2019 • Couples
Whether choosing Vietnamese dishes or Western grill, the food was excellent! The menu choices were extensive. We focused on the Vietnamese dishes, and based on our trip around Vietnam these were among the best we tasted. The service was outstanding - they really did absolutely everything they could to make us have a good evening. This is the main restaurant in the excellent Salinda resort. It is on the expensive side relative to general Vietnamese pricing but given the quality and its location within the resort complex we had no cause to want to go elsewhere! (It is also worth noting that the breakfast buffet is also served here with a vast array of options along with a la carte eggs and tea/coffee to order. A number of people also enjoyed the free-flowing complimentary sparkling wine!)

Five Star Restaurant with Ambiance and High Quality Food
Jan 2019 • Couples
We were lucky to have arrived on the night that the Salinda restaurant was having a buffet BBQ event with live music. The spread was absolutely amazing, the ambiance and the live band were all perfect and made for a perfect arrival to this beautiful resort. We ate another night here and although Vietnamese Cuisine is not our favorite, the quality of food was very good. The desserts were spectacular so save room! The Salinda Resort is perfect in every way including the main restaurant. The buffet breakfast was excellent, with a good variety of options for different cuisine tastes. Even the cappuccino and lattes were included unlike many other resorts. The staff are excellent and service superb. Highly recommended.
